title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Habit and Productivity Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a habit or productivity app: reminders that arrive, streaks and history, widgets and quick capture, sync across devices, and a plan structure that fits the category.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 75 out of 80, because it builds streaks, push reminders, cross-device sync, an AI coach, and RevenueCat plans on one database. Rork is second at 52.


Yes, with native push. Blink adds push notifications from a sentence and tests them on a real phone, while Base44's web view wrapper has no native push.


RevenueCat's 2026 data shows Productivity takes 91% of its revenue from monthly plans, while Health and Fitness takes 59% from annual. Blink sets up both through RevenueCat.
